_: mandarin-ids.json — the number in each Mandarin card's id, pinned to its note: <deck id> → <headword> → N, for the id u_<deck id>_N. Seeded from the decks as shipped on 2026-11-15 by mandarin-order.js --seed-ids. Never delete or renumber a row: the Update press merges a reader's progress by id. A new note takes the next free number. mandarin-fix.js --check asserts every deck agrees with this file.
